Contemporary legal analysis corroborates the Slovenian draft's express treatment of general-purpose AI and establishes that this was publicly discussed in 2021.
Original French presidency progress report describes revisions to existing general-purpose AI provisions.
Earlier Slovenian progress report also describes general-purpose AI provisions, but the subsequent dated compromise provides the actual proposed wording.
Its May 2022 entry identifies the French intervention but does not establish that general-purpose AI was first mentioned then.
Retrospective scholarship corroborates the Slovenian-to-French sequence; contemporary documents suffice.
